bear_case: BTC's reversal from $63,900 to ~$61,677 is the session's most significant regime warning. Tonight's UTC midnight close (8 PM ET) is the decisive gate — with BTC at risk of resetting the two-gate framework entirely. Strategy's $216M BTC Monetization disclosure (3,588 BTC, $60,200 avg) confirms the largest corporate BTC treasury has pivoted from accumulator to recurring seller: if this program executes quarterly at $200–300M per tranche, it represents 1,500–2,000+ BTC of recurring institutional supply into every rally. NVDA's $0.84 Stop Day 2 survival margin means any overnight pre-market dip below $195 triggers the mandatory full exit at July 7 open. The FOMC minutes on July 8, written from the committee's June 17 data backdrop (pre-57K NFP, pre-ISM), will likely read more hawkish relative to current market pricing — potentially repricing the July 28 hike probability back toward 25–30% and compressing the Nasdaq P/E ~28x multiple that underpins the dual-gate BUY thesis. June CPI on July 14 at 4.2% (May baseline) remains the regime's ultimate arbiter. Invalidation: if BTC holds above $62,000 on tonight's UTC midnight close AND SPX closes above 7,460 on July 7 (Dual-gate Day 2), the near-term bear case weakens materially. If both conditions fail simultaneously, the call reverts to HOLD pending June CPI July 14.
